mod.anythingbutfish.name: AnythingButFish
mod.anythingbutfish.description: Replaces vanilla fishing loot with completely random items, entities, and experience orbs.
config.anythingbutfish.title: AnythingButFish Config
config.anythingbutfish.cat.general.toolt: Configure drop chances, item counts, XP amounts, and fling physics.
config.anythingbutfish.cat.misc.tooltip: Toggle mod features: master switch, debug mode, infinite durability, loot chest rods, and modded rod compatibility.
config.anythingbutfish.cat.itemPool.tool:
Weighted item pool for fishing loot.
Format: 'namespace:name:weight' or 'namespace:name:weight:minCount:maxCount'.
Leave empty to pick randomly from the entire item registry.
config.anythingbutfish.cat.entityPool.to:
Weighted entity pool for fishing loot.
Format: 'namespace:name:weight'.
Leave empty to pick randomly from the entire entity registry.
config.anythingbutfish.group.chances.des:
Controls the probability of each outcome when reeling in.
The three chances are independent — the remainder becomes 'the one that got away'.
Example: 60% item + 25% entity + 10% XP = 5% nothing.
config.anythingbutfish.group.items.desc:
Default stack size range for randomly caught items.
Individual item pool entries can override these values.
config.anythingbutfish.group.xp.desc: Controls the range of experience points awarded when the XP outcome is rolled.
config.anythingbutfish.group.physics.des: Controls how items, entities, and XP orbs fly toward the player after reeling in.
config.anythingbutfish.group.switches.de: Toggle individual mod features on or off.
config.anythingbutfish.enabled.tooltip:
Master switch for the entire mod.
§aEnabled§r: Fishing loot is replaced with random results.
§cDisabled§r: Vanilla fishing behavior is fully restored — fish normally.
config.anythingbutfish.debugMode.tooltip:
When enabled, every reel-in prints the result to your chat and the game log.
Useful for testing pool configurations.
§7Example: '[ABF] Item: minecraft:diamond x2'§r
config.anythingbutfish.infiniteDurabilit:
Prevents fishing rods from losing durability.
§aEnabled§r: Rods never break — cast and reel as many times as you like.
§cDisabled§r: Normal durability loss applies.
§7Note: Works for vanilla rods and modded rods that extend FishingRodItem.§r
config.anythingbutfish.replaceLootChestR: Add Fresh Rod to Bonus Chest

When enabled, a fresh (undamaged, unenchanted) fishing rod is added to the world spawn Bonus Chest loot table (minecraft:chests/spawn_bonus_chest).
The Bonus Chest is the optional starter chest generated at world spawn when you enable 'Bonus Chest' during world creation.
§7Note: This adds a new rod alongside existing bonus chest loot — it does not remove the original entries.§r
config.anythingbutfish.moddedRodCompat.t:
Enables compatibility with modded fishing rods.
§aEnabled§r: Any fishing rod that uses the vanilla FishingHook entity will trigger random loot — this includes most modded rods.
§7Note: This is already active by default since the mixin targets FishingHook directly. This toggle is informational.§r
Controls whether modded items can appear in the random item pool.
§aEnabled§r: Items from all namespaces (vanilla + mods) are eligible — you might reel in anything!
§cDisabled§r: Only vanilla Minecraft items (minecraft: namespace) can be caught.
§7Note: This only applies when the Item Pool list is empty (full-registry random mode). Custom pool entries are not affected.§r
config.anythingbutfish.allowModdedEntiti:
Controls whether modded entities can appear in the random entity pool.
§aEnabled§r: Entities from all namespaces (vanilla + mods) are eligible.
§cDisabled§r: Only vanilla Minecraft entities (minecraft: namespace) can be spawned.
§7Note: This only applies when the Entity Pool list is empty (full-registry random mode). Custom pool entries are not affected.§r
config.anythingbutfish.chanceItem.toolti:
Probability of catching a random item when reeling in.
Range: 0–100. §cSet to 0% to disable item drops entirely.§r
The remaining percentage after all three chances is the 'one that got away' chance.
config.anythingbutfish.chanceEntity.tool:
Probability of spawning a random entity when reeling in.
Range: 0–100. §cSet to 0% to disable entity spawning entirely.§r
Entities are flung toward the player just like items.
config.anythingbutfish.chanceXp.tooltip:
Probability of receiving experience orbs when reeling in.
Range: 0–100. §cSet to 0% to disable XP drops entirely.§r
The XP amount is randomly chosen between Min XP and Max XP.
config.anythingbutfish.itemCountMin.tool:
Minimum number of items in a randomly caught stack.
Range: 1–64. Must be ≤ Max Item Stack Size.
§7Individual item pool entries can override this with their own minCount/maxCount.§r
config.anythingbutfish.itemCountMax.tool:
Maximum number of items in a randomly caught stack.
Range: 1–64. Must be ≥ Min Item Stack Size.
§7Individual item pool entries can override this with their own minCount/maxCount.§r
config.anythingbutfish.xpMin.tooltip:
Minimum experience points awarded when the XP outcome is rolled.
Range: 1–1000.
config.anythingbutfish.xpMax.tooltip:
Maximum experience points awarded when the XP outcome is rolled.
Range: 1–1000. Must be ≥ Min XP Amount.
config.anythingbutfish.flingSpeed.toolti:
Horizontal speed multiplier for items/entities/orbs flying toward the player.
Higher values = faster horizontal movement.
Range: 0.01–1.0. Default: 0.10.
config.anythingbutfish.flingArc.tooltip:
Upward arc multiplier for the fling trajectory.
Higher values = higher arc (items fly up more before coming down).
Range: 0.0–1.0. Default: 0.08.
config.anythingbutfish.itemPool.tooltip:
Weighted list of items that can be caught.
§eFormat:§r 'namespace:name:weight'
§eExtended:§r 'namespace:name:weight:minCount:maxCount'
§eExample:§r 'minecraft:diamond:5' or 'minecraft:cod:20:1:5'
§7Weight is relative — higher weight = more likely to be picked.
§cSet weight to -1 to disable an entry.§r
Leave the list empty to pick randomly from the entire item registry.§r
config.anythingbutfish.entityPool.toolti:
Weighted list of entities that can be spawned.
§eFormat:§r 'namespace:name:weight'
§eExample:§r 'minecraft:creeper:3' or 'minecraft:pig:10'
§7Weight is relative — higher weight = more likely to be picked.
§cSet weight to -1 to disable an entry.§r
Leave the list empty to pick randomly from the entire entity registry.§r
